// Run when one dies: counts it for the quest CaravanQuest (stage 2). Generated by build_regions.py
01	Get.Value	ATTRIBUTE	CaravanQuest	Variable.1$
02	>Conditional	$Variable.1=2	12
03	Get.Value	ATTRIBUTE	ScorpionsSlain	Variable.2$
04	>Conditional	$Variable.2<4	12
05	Update.Attribute	ScorpionsSlain	+1
06	Get.Value	CALCULATION	$Variable.2+1	Variable.2$
07	>Conditional	$Variable.2<4	10
08	Display.Message	Yellow	Scorpions slain at the wreck: $Variable.2 of 4.
09	End
10	Quest.Note.Done	CaravanQuest	Slay the scorpions at the wreck.
11	Display.Message	Yellow	Four scorpions! Find the ledger and return to Qadir in Dunerest.
12	End
